1-1.description: A faction war needs a delivery of weapons and supplies past the enemy line.

2-2.description: A fugitive will pay to be smuggled into the next system.

3-3.description: A Cult wants you to move their Chosen One past a Church/ Legion checkpoint.

4-4.description: Living cargo needs to be transported, but is hard to contain and pin down once loose.

5-5.description: A client wants you to move a package for two weeks straight. No stopping. No peeking.

6-6.description: Transporting the goods is easy, but can you convince a socialite to give you the job?

7-7.description: Someone wants you to accept a job for a faction, but give them the goods instead.

8-8.description: An ace pilot wants you to smuggle their custom, illegally modified racing ship to the start line past Guild inspections.

9-9.description: A simple job, except the cargo isn’t what they said it was, and it gets dangerous mid-trip.

10-10.description: Smuggle a Way creature to a planetside mystic. Just one problem—it has to be carried inside one of the crew.

11-11.description: Smuggle an artifact out of an archaeological dig.

12-12.description: Run a Guild trade embargo to get a key scientist off the planet.

13-13.description: Transport of cargo requires a path through a pirate’s boobytrapped and patrolled turf.

14-14.description: An exiled ex-pirate stashed a treasure on Baftoma and will split it with whoever can get them there past pirates and back.

15-15.description: A mystic needs a crew to explore a newly formed Way line. Way beasties guaranteed.

16-16.description: A Sah’iir wishes to adopt xeno children as servants. They must be moved before they are registered with the Hegemony.

17-17.description: Priority shipment from Indri to Amerath can only make it in time if you cut through the Belt of Fire.

18-18.description: A criminal gang needs to smuggle a message to a lifer in Isotropa Max Secure.

1-1.description: The Legion is holding an ally in a facility surrounded by toxic waters on Aleph.

2-2.description: The Hegemony has troops in place to keep local xenos in line. Run a blockade to get them supplies.

3-3.description: A local faction found your staging base and is using it, but you need it for an upcoming job.

4-4.description: A Hegemonic bureaucrat with incriminating info wants to defect, but needs help getting out.

5-5.description: Recruit a hotshot pilot who knows a secret route for your next job.

6-6.description: Important sympathizers have clandestine information to hand off at a fancy party.

7-7.description: A Hegemonic defector is on the run with blueprints and plans.

8-8.description: You hear of an Ur artifact that might help your fight. Just one problem—it’s got weird effects and Way creatures guarding it.

9-9.description: Capture the plans for a new prototype Guild weapon from a secure data depot.

10-10.description: Raid a Guild convoy for much-needed supplies.

11-11.description: Disable some ground support for a strike against the Legion.

12-12.description: A Cult needs you to fend off the Church of Stellar Flame so their Chosen One can escape to safety.

13-13.description: A key Noble or dignitary is visiting the sector. Assassinate or kidnap them.

14-14.description: The Memish are rebelling. Can you shut off the gate so the Hegemony doesn’t send battleships to pacify them?

15-15.description: A bounty hunter has a rebel leader. Stop them and get the leader back.

16-16.description: Help a terraforming settlement the Hegemony has abandoned.

17-17.description: A rebel leader has been released from prison. He may have key information from the inside, but it’s almost certainly a trap.

18-18.description: A rebel ship is damaged and hiding. They need you to escort them to safety.

1-1.description: A Syndicate courier ran with his package. Nab him before he sells it to another Syndicate.

2-2.description: A Noble’s servant (with secrets) is running. Fight any others who want to claim the bounty.

3-3.description: Someone stole the Starsmith’s prototype vessel. Hunt them down.

4-4.description: A Legionnaire defector has been missing for years, but a rumor of their location surfaces.

5-5.description: The child of a diplomat was kidnapped in transit. Spring them from pirates.

6-6.description: A bounty is placed on a dangerous Way creature on Aketi.

7-7.description: A large prison breakout happens on Isotropa Max Secure. Gotta catch them all.

8-8.description: A Scarlet Wolf assassin just inexplicably killed a large number of people. Get them.

9-9.description: A large bounty is out for someone who just blew up a chunk of a jumpgate. The person blamed claims they didn’t do it.

10-10.description: Find a lost researcher for the Guild (whether they want to come back or not).

11-11.description: Mendicants are hiding a former pirate. Fetch them for the Vignerons.

12-12.description: Extract a Guild member from the local Guild headquarters. Good luck.

13-13.description: Catch a Noble’s escaped pet and deal with it on the transport back.

14-14.description: A Syndicate leader wants to make an example of a gambler not making good on some large debts. No disintegrations.

15-15.description: A fugitive has gone to ground on an inhospitable planet or region of space.

16-16.description: A Cobalt Syndicate rabble-rouser is being hidden by his people.

17-17.description: Retrieve an item from a vessel captured by pirates. (Crew rescue optional.)

18-18.description: A hacker has taken over some satellites. Disable their hacking and capture them.

1-1.description: An element is a cover for a Hegemonic Cult

2-2.description: A mystic or visions have alerted your target ahead of time

3-3.description: Someone on the job isn’t who they say they are.

4-4.description: The location is guarded or watched by Hegemonic forces.

5-5.description: This job furthers a mystic or xeno group’s agenda.

6-6.description: This job furthers a Guild’s agenda.

7-7.description: The target is a front or member of a criminal group.

8-8.description: The job is on a dangerous gang’s turf.

9-9.description: The job is a trap laid by your enemies.

10-10.description: The job is a test for another job.

11-11.description: The job furthers pirate goals and agendas.

12-12.description: The job is being closely watched by a wealthy patron.

13-13.description: The job has a strong Precursor or Way line presence.

14-14.description: The job is in the middle of actively contested turf.

15-15.description: The job is not planetside, or easy to get to.

16-16.description: The location moves (it’s not where you expect it to be).

17-17.description: The job aids a rebellious cause.

18-18.description: The job directly affects the Governor.
